entries.title: Photos and notes go with a card's buttons on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: On your iPhone and iPad, a photo or a note you queued in a card's field now goes with the button you press, together with your words, and a line above the buttons says what goes. A past card names the notes and photos that went with its choice. Against a computer that has not updated yet, the buttons wait until you send them as a reply, so nothing is lost.
entries.noPicture: The phone draws the same line and past card as the computer's window, whose picture the note on pictures, files and notes going with a card's buttons carries; the phone's own screens are photographed only by its device check.
